sloka: पुत्रस्य भाषितं श्रुत्वा परमार्तस्य रोदतः ।देवयानी तु सङ्क्रुद्धा सस्मार पितरं तदा ।। ७.५८.१५ ॥
transliteration: putrasya bhāṣitaṁ śrutvā paramārtasya rodataḥ ।devayānī tu saṅkruddhā sasmāra pitaraṁ tadā ।। 7.58.15 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of her greatly distressed and weeping son, Devayani became exceedingly enraged and then remembered her father.
